title: Implement data pipeline integration tests
objective: Integration tests verify the full pipeline from fetch through cache through quality check, using mocked Alpaca responses with realistic data

test_scenarios.name: test_full_fetch_cache_read_cycle
test_scenarios.verifies: Fetch -> write Parquet -> read back -> data matches

test_scenarios.name: test_partial_cache_refetch
test_scenarios.verifies: Cached range + missing range -> only missing fetched

test_scenarios.name: test_rth_filtering_end_to_end
test_scenarios.verifies: Raw data with extended hours -> filtered to 390 bars/day

test_scenarios.name: test_quality_on_clean_data
test_scenarios.verifies: Clean fetched data passes all quality checks

test_scenarios.name: test_quality_on_gapped_data
test_scenarios.verifies: Data with intentional gaps detected correctly

test_scenarios.name: test_multi_symbol_temporal_alignment
test_scenarios.verifies: Multiple symbols share identical timestamp index

test_scenarios.name: test_dst_transition_handling
test_scenarios.verifies: Data spanning DST change has correct RTH boundaries

acceptance_criteria: Tests use mocked HTTP responses (no real Alpaca calls)
Fixture JSON contains realistic multi-page Alpaca response
Tests exercise ParquetStore with real filesystem (tmp_path)
Cache hit path verified (second call does not trigger fetch)
Quality report on pipeline output shows is_clean=True
DST test covers both spring-forward and fall-back
